surface_mechanism_description: The plasma treatment creates dangling bonds or absorbate centers on MoS2 surfaces, which can enhance the absorption of water molecules. This can promote the charge transfer at the MoS2/electrolyte interface and the release of gas bubble on the MoS2 surface.
